notes: Agent-layer evaluation. Each case runs through run_agentic_completion directly, so it measures tool selection and answer grounding — NOT prescreen, risk routing or validation, which run before/after the agent in the full pipeline. expect_tools: every listed tool must be called. forbid_tools: none of these may be called ('*' = no tools at all). must_contain: every string must appear in the answer (case-insensitive). refusal: the answer must be the off-domain refusal.
